title: Expro Launches Maestro® to put Human Decision-making at the Heart of Automated Well Testing
summary: Launched ahead of ADIPEC 2026, Expro’s Maestro® platform combines human-controlled automation with up to 67% lower red-zone exposure.
body_markdown:
Expro has launched Maestro®, a modular well test platform combining automation and remote control while keeping people at the center of critical decision-making.


A full Maestro® deployment can reduce red-zone exposure by up to 67%, helping keep personnel away from complex operations around live well-test equipment.


The launch comes as energy companies look to automate more high-risk operations while retaining human oversight of critical decisions, a theme set to feature prominently at ADIPEC 2026. Traditional well-test operations often rely on manually intensive processes and routine intervention. Maestro® combines automation, real-time visibility and decision support in a modular platform designed to reduce operational complexity across onshore and offshore environments.


Maestro® is underpinned by Expro’s Verified Decision Control (VDC) approach, which keeps people in control of critical decisions. The system uses data and automation to monitor well-test conditions and propose a response. Real-time visibility and automated alerts help experienced personnel identify potential operational issues, make informed decisions faster and confirm what happens next.


**Andrei Ion, Vice President of Well Flow Management at Expro, said:**


“The energy industry is moving quickly towards more automated operations, but automation should not mean removing human judgement from critical decisions.


“Maestro® has been designed to help operators embrace automation while maintaining visibility and control. Our aim with it is simple: reduce people out of hazardous environments, not out of decisions.”


“Customers trust the skills and experience of our people. Maestro® builds on that expertise, using automation in an effort to improve safety and operational performance while keeping experienced well-test personnel in control of what happens next.”


Its modular design allows Maestro® to be configured for different projects, assets and operating environments. The system builds on Expro’s existing EDGE and Data to Desk technology, providing real-time well-test data, monitoring and remote access.
